title: Firebag 原位油砂
summary: Firebag 是蒸汽輔助重力排油與汽電共生案例；課程只分析公開原理的熱量、電力與水循環帳。本課依序分析冷水等值蒸汽油比、共生系統熱分配、輸配電損失、回水與補水分界、熱量與產油時間窗，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Firebag is a SAGD and cogeneration case; the course analyses heat, electricity and recycled-water balances at public-principle level. The course analyses cold-water-equivalent steam-oil ratio, thermal allocation in cogeneration, electrical distribution loss, returned-water versus make-up boundary, heat and oil-output time windows, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Cold-water-equivalent steam-oil ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = Qo SOR rho Δh/86400；代入 Qo = 1125 m³ oil/day、SOR = 2.8 m³ cold-water-equivalent/m³ oil、dh = 2200 kJ/kg，得 80.2 MW（「冷水等值蒸汽油比」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 SOR 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = Qo SOR rho Δh/86400; with Qo = 1125 m³ oil/day, SOR = 2.8 m³ cold-water-equivalent/m³ oil, dh = 2200 kJ/kg the result is 80.2 MW (simplified exercise for Cold-water-equivalent steam-oil ratio; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise SOR by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：SOR 增加 10% 時，結果變為 88.2 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising SOR by 10% changes the result to 88.2 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 80.2 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 SOR 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 80.2 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in SOR with an engineering explanation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要增加熱交換面積就能回收全部廢熱。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing exchanger area recovers all waste heat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「共生系統熱分配」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。流量計漂移、比熱取值錯誤和換熱面結垢都可能使溫差變化；只看出口溫度不能區分熱源不足與傳熱能力下降。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Thermal allocation in cogeneration” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Flowmeter drift, incorrect heat capacity and exchanger fouling can all alter temperatures; outlet temperature alone cannot distinguish a weaker heat source from degraded heat transfer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
